name: Classroom API to GitHub Issues - DMI and PWA

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { course: 'PWA', triggerKind: 'schedule', attempt: 1 } }];
return [{ json: { course: 'DMI', triggerKind: 'schedule', attempt: 1 } }];
const context = $('Prepare Classroom Request').item.json; return [{ json: { ...context, classroomResponse: $json } }];
if (Number($json.attempt) !== 1) throw new Error('Retry guard: sólo se permite un retry'); return [{ json: { ...$json, attempt: 2 } }];
const context = $('Increment Retry').item.json; return [{ json: { ...context, classroomResponse: $json } }];
const context = $('Inspect Materials').item.json; return [{ json: { ...context, driveMetadata: $json } }];
const context = $('Validate Drive File').item.json; return [{ json: context, binary: $binary }];
return $input.all();

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=' + encodeURIComponent('repo:' + $('Activity Context').item.json.repository + ' is:issue in:body "course:' + $('Activity Context').item.json.course + '" "week:' + $('Activity Context').item.json.weekPadded + '"') + '&per_page=100' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: $json.systemPrompt }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.userPrompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseJsonSchema: $json.geminiSchema } }) }}

={{ ({ model: ($env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen2.5-coder:7b'), messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.userPrompt }], stream: false, think: false, format: $json.schema, options: { temperature: 0.1, num_ctx: 8192, num_predict: 5000 } }) }}

={{ ({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: $json.systemPrompt }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.retryPrompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0, responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseJsonSchema: $json.geminiSchema } }) }}

={{ ({ model: ($env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen2.5-coder:7b'), messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.retryPrompt }], stream: false, think: false, format: $json.schema, options: { temperature: 0, num_ctx: 8192, num_predict: 5000 } }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const errors = ($json.validationErrors || []).map((e) => '[' + (e.code || 'ERROR') + '] ' + (e.message || e)).join('; '); throw new Error('Plan inválido tras reintento: ' + (errors || 'sin errores') + '. GitHub no fue modificado.');
return [{ json: $('Plan and Topological Sort').item.json }];
